# What the diverted Dialpad sends over the Bolt receiver, slot 3, as
# unsolicited reports: diverted-control notifications of 0x1B04 (index
# 0x0a) and rotation notifications of 0x4610 (index 0x0d, event 0), plus
# the Dialpad's own status reports, which are no input.
#
# Source: own, the owner's hardware check of slice 7 (#187, part 2,
# 2026-10-30, https://github.com/qubernetic/keyvo/issues/187#issuecomment-6517302440),
# `keyvo --dump dial` at 8f56281, Dialpad firmware RBO 07.00.B0016: the
# blocks "buttons", the five rotation blocks and the first two frames of
# "wake, search, diverts", every frame in the dump's order; the `#` lines
# name the dump's ms. A rotation report is `<roller> <delta i8> <u32
# big-endian timestamp>`; roller 0 is the small roller, 1 the dial, + is
# clockwise (forward on the roller). A held button does not repeat: the
# held-CID list changes only on an edge.
#
# 1. 0x1D4B (index 0x04) reconnect and 0x1004 (index 0x09) battery, 90 %,
#    full (ms 32611 and 32626): no input
< 11 03 04 00 01 01 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 09 00 5a 08 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
# 2. buttons (ms 287978 to 296040): 3, 4, 1 and 2 pressed and released
#    once each, 1 held for 2.6 s, then 2 held and 1 with it, 2 let go
#    first
< 11 03 0a 00 00 59 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 5a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 53 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 56 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 53 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 56 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 56 00 53 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 53 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
< 11 03 0a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
